description: This file defines serializers for abstract types in the Orleans serialization system, including a generic abstract serializer and a wrapper, with functionality for writing, reading, serializing, and deserializing abstract class and interface types.

classes.name: AbstractTypeSerializer<TField>
classes.description: Serializer for abstract types (classes or interfaces), implements IFieldCodec and IBaseCodec for TField, with methods for writing, reading, serializing, and deserializing instances.

classes.name: AbstractTypeSerializerWrapper<TField>
classes.description: Sealed internal wrapper class for AbstractTypeSerializer, implements IFieldCodec for TField, providing a minimal wrapper.

classes.name: AbstractTypeSerializer
classes.description: Base class providing core functionality for serializing abstract types, including methods for writing and reading fields based on type information, and handling nulls and references.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a field; handles null references and delegates to a specific serializer obtained from CodecProvider.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a value of type TField, handling references and missing field types.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Virtual method intended to serialize an instance of TField; default implementation does nothing.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data into an existing TField instance, consuming end of object marker.
